guesses.reason: The fawn-brindle coat with white blaze and chest, slightly shortened dark-masked muzzle, and loose flews strongly suggest Boxer ancestry.
The broad skull, muscular neck, medium athletic build, and semi-folded rose-type ears point to pit bull-type heritage.
The compact, stocky frame and wide cheeks are also consistent with Staffordshire-type contribution.

breed.appearance: Mina is a medium, muscular short-coated dog with a warm fawn-tan coat overlaid with subtle dark brindle striping, a white blaze running up the left side of her face between her eyes, a white muzzle and a bright white chest. She has a broad head, a moderately short muzzle with a darker mask around the black nose and lips, soft dark-brown almond eyes, and medium ears that stand partly up and fold over at the tips, the right ear flipped back to show its pink inner side. She wears a teal martingale collar with a silver ring and is sitting attentively on a gray car seat.
breed.fun_fact: Boxers are famous for their playful 'kidney bean' wiggle dance when they're happy, so expect plenty of joyful greetings!
